אדרא-כינויים.notes: Cluster from the Naso 136-137b passages. רישא חוורא = 'the white head'; רעוא דרעוין = 'delight-in-delightings' (USER-CONFIRMED). ra'ava family: noun='delight', verb='delight in'/'delighting in'; 'favor' and 'will' REJECTED (favoritism/favor-giving connotations; no English word carries will+active-pleasure together, so the hyphenated form is used); טמירא דטמירין = 'the concealed of the concealed'; בוצינא/בוצינין = 'lamp(s)' (luminaries = the Sefirot); קרומא = 'membrane' (krooma dakik='a thin membrane'; krooma kashisha stima'ah='a hard, concealed membrane'); חמשין תרעין = 'the fifty gates' (Binah), with נ' יומין דאורייתא='the fifty days of the Torah', נ' שנין דיובלא='the fifty years of the Jubilee', נ' אלף דרין='the fifty thousand generations'.

כינוי.notes: USER-CONFIRMED: render 'allusion(s)', NOT 'epithet'/'appellation'. The recurring cross-referenced gate שער ערכי הכינויים = 'the Gate of the Values of the Allusions' (each divine name 'alludes to' a Sefirah). Earlier-chunk renderings 'Epithets'/'Appellations' were retroactively unified to 'Allusions'.
